# Generated Files Policy

What can be generated and committed.

---

## Purpose

Generated Files Policy defines how generated artifacts are handled.

---

## Rules

1. Generated files must be reproducible.
2. Generated files should be marked.
3. Generated files should not hide source of truth.
4. Do not commit secrets.
5. Generated schemas or docs should be validated.
6. AI-generated code must be reviewed.

---

## North Star

Generated files should accelerate work without reducing trust.
